operating_rules: CURRENT contains at most one actively implemented product train and may be empty between merged trains.
NEXT is ordered and contains concrete player-facing trains, not cleanup placeholders.
Canonical Zork solutions remain valid even when new physically valid workarounds are added.
A reusable object or learned workaround remains useful wherever the same physical logic reasonably applies.
Cleverness should reduce repeated friction rather than create a new fetch-grind tax.
Soft sequence breaks are allowed only when physically earned, state-safe, and non-bricking.
Mara remains one authored human adventurer; no approval meter, generic follower framework, skill tree, or omniscient companion AI.
No universal crafting grid, arbitrary object-pair matrix, generic physics simulator, recursive audit machinery, TODO-only slice, or no-op scaffolding.
DONE requires merged or otherwise immutable proof.

current.title: Mara Causal Biography & Shared Danger
current.outcome: Make Mara's later choices visibly depend on named lived facts from shared danger, exact custody, rescue, promise keeping or breaking, abandonment, reciprocal rescue, and private experience rather than a global approval score.
current.showcase: Mara can decide herself to inspect the real Dam ladder, be injured and rescued, entrust her exact measured rope, remember whether that rope was returned as promised, later catch the Adventurer in the same physical hazard when the lived evidence supports it, and privately acquire a survey discovery she discloses only when asked.
boundaries: new causal decisions do not consult legacy TRUST RESPECT or SAFETY scalar slots
no dating-sim meter or generic psychology engine
no omniscient companion AI or generic party framework
no duplicate Dam hazard ladder or rope authority
Release 1253 Dam survival remains authoritative outside Mara's narrow intervention

next.title: Mara Field Capability Discovery
next.outcome: Build capability biography rather than a skill tree: authored situations reveal helpful abilities and latent abilities Mara herself did not know she could perform, then later let her deliberately reuse what she learned.
next.showcase: House rest can heal current Dam injury without erasing its history; survey geometry can become an improvised pendulum traversal over the River Frigid; recovered physical survey evidence can lead into a bounded acoustic-ranging discovery around the canyon/Loud Room; at least one discovery is later reused intentionally.
boundaries: no XP perk menu class system or generic skill framework
no superpowers or sudden personality rewrite
no automatic puzzle solving or hint-engine behavior
surprise abilities must grow from Mara's existing survey math field practice observation and lived danger
Mara remains independent fallible and capable of refusing a route

future.title: Mara Longer Biography
future.outcome: Extend causal biography through recovery, conflicting promises, longer separation, private discoveries, archive disagreement, thief manipulation, troll judgment, offscreen mistakes, repair after betrayal, changing interpretations, deeper friendship, and optional romance only if lived history earns it.

future.title: Treasure Guardian Dragon & Hoard
future.outcome: Create an original Zork-native dragon guarding a real treasure hoard, with territorial warning signs, dangerous fire breath, persistent environmental consequences, and multiple credible Zork-style approaches.
boundaries: fire breath composes with Release 1257 authored fire smoke material shelter and escape systems
not a generic hit-point boss fight
do not copy Shadowgate source code text art maps exact puzzles or expressive sequencing

future.title: Cross-IF / RPG Mechanics Adaptation — Shadowgate First
future.outcome: Study high-value mechanics and interaction patterns from other interactive-fiction games and RPGs, beginning with Shadowgate, then rebuild selected concepts from scratch as original Zork-native systems.
boundaries: borrow concepts and design lessons not source code text art maps exact puzzles or expressive sequencing
keep the separate S.T.A.L.K.E.R. Glulx product lane distinct

future.title: Forest That Answers Back / Described World = Interactive World
future.outcome: Turn selected concrete nouns already present in authored forest descriptions into targetable stateful world objects whose interactions compose with existing physicality.

future.title: Time, Weather & Disaster Arc
future.outcome: Layer authored time and weather conditions plus selected disasters onto real geography and material state to create preparation shelter traversal rescue and aftermath play.

future.title: Causal Death & Warning Depth
future.outcome: Broaden fair cause-warning-consequence chains near-death records delayed consequences and exact-object provenance without turning death into a generic simulation framework.

future.title: Museum & Ecology Second Expansion
future.outcome: Continue physical specimen provenance collection and ecology stories only where they create new field play rather than checklist accumulation.

future.title: Narrative Perspective Experiments
future.outcome: Build isolated first-person third-person and interactive-storybook editions against real canonical state without changing normal Zork.

future.title: DRAW + Multi-Agent Experiments
future.outcome: Explore DRAW and multi-agent interactive-fiction experiments only after the playable product supports them.

parked.title: S.T.A.L.K.E.R. Glulx Game
parked.outcome: Remain a separate interactive-fiction product lane, never mixed into a Zork gameplay PR.

parked.title: Protected Corpus Acquisition
